text: No, the entire property was not cleared in 2021. Earth-observation data shows tree-cover loss totaled about 81.3 hectares—just 2.23% of the 3,643.5-hectare asset. The change occurred in a planted forest area (mostly *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), not native forest. The loss was detected as stand replacement (e.g., harvesting), not necessarily deforestation or land-use change. Smaller patches (under 0.5 ha) accounting for 37.3 ha were excluded from the total. The evidence does not indicate widespread clearing across the full property.
